description: Check authoritative Gmail receipt scan status. Returns the active lock and live phase/progress shown in-app, queued or attention-needed periods, completed calendar years, and tax-period statuses with their returned labels and inclusive ISO bounds, plus exclusions and recent outcomes. Use when asked if a scan is running, finished, stuck, or what it is doing. On completion show spreadsheetUrl or reviewExpensesUrl; for setup/reconnection show gmailScanUrl. Read-only.
name: get_scan_status

outputSchema.description: Authoritative live scan state. Fields may sit at the top level or under data depending on the branch; nothing beyond success is guaranteed, so treat each as optional.

latestScan.description: Most recent scan outcome (success, emailsFound, emailsTagged, timestamp).

lock.description: Scan-lock state (active, startedAt, ageSeconds, dispatchComplete, pendingProcessingCount).
